Kuvitus: akustinen kitara makaa avatussa: Illustration: an acoustic guitar lies in its open case, seen from above. On the neck there is a capo, which presses the strings against the fretboard at the third fret. One of the strings has been plucked and is vibrating: the string moves most halfway between the capo and the bridge and stays still at both ends, and the range of its motion is shown in light blue. The case is on a wooden floor, with a pick beside it.
Kaavakuva kolmena hetkenä allekkain, ei: Diagram of three moments one below the other, not to scale: the right end of a rope is fixed to a wall. The orange dashed line is the wave travelling towards the wall and the violet dotted line is the wave reflected from the wall, with the same amplitude and wavelength. The blue solid line is their sum, that is, the actual shape of the rope. At the top moment the incident and the reflected wave overlap and the sum is greatest, at the middle moment it is smaller, and at the bottom moment it is zero, when the waves cancel each other. The black dots mark points where the sum is zero at every moment: they are half a wavelength apart, and one of them is at the wall.
Kaavakuva seisovasta aallosta, ei mittak: Diagram of a standing wave, not to scale. The blue solid line is the shape of the rope at one moment and the blue dashed line half a period later; the light area between them is the region where the rope moves. The black dots N are nodes, where the rope does not move. Halfway between them are the antinodes A, where the motion is greatest. The distance between two adjacent nodes is marked as half a wavelength and the distance from a node to the adjacent antinode as a quarter of a wavelength.
Kaavakuva: kahdesta päästä kiinnitetty k: Diagram: a string of length L fixed at both ends vibrating at its three lowest natural frequencies, one below the other. In the top one half a wavelength fits on the string, in the middle one two halves and in the bottom one three halves. The ends of the string are always nodes. On the right is the condition for each row: L is one, two or three times half a wavelength.
Kaavakuva neljästä samanpituisesta putke: Diagram of four tubes of the same length L. The standing wave of the air displacement is drawn inside the tubes: the light area shows how much the air moves along the tube at each point. At the top is a tube open at both ends at the fundamental frequency, with antinodes at the ends and a node in the middle, and at the second natural frequency. At the bottom is a tube closed at one end: there is always a node at the closed end and an antinode at the open end. At the fundamental frequency a quarter of a wavelength fits in the tube and at the next natural frequency three quarters. On the right is the condition for each tube.
Kuva mittakaavassa: vaakasuora naru, jon: Figure to scale: a horizontal rope, one end of which is fixed to a vibrator on the left and the other passes over a pulley on the right, with a weight hanging from its end. The part between the vibrator and the pulley vibrates as a standing wave with four loops of equal length and five nodes counting the ends. Under the rope is a ruler whose scale is in metres from zero to 1.20 metres at intervals of 0.20 metres; the vibrator is at zero and the pulley at 1.20 metres.
